name: io.github.WYRE-AI/dubber-mcp
title: Dubber
description: MCP server for Dubber: call recordings, groups, accounts, users, notifications (REST hooks), and Dub.Point.

environmentVariables.name: DUBBER_AUTH_ID
environmentVariables.description: Dubber Auth ID (Dubber portal → API tab)

environmentVariables.name: DUBBER_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Dubber Auth Token (Dubber portal → API tab)

environmentVariables.name: DUBBER_REGION
environmentVariables.description: API region segment, e.g. 'sandbox' for testing.

environmentVariables.name: DUBBER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL override (env mode only; overrides DUBBER_REGION)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
